facts.fact: The Civil Registry Act 2011, an act of the National Assembly signed by the President, repealed the 2001 Act, came into force on signature, and sets up the civil registry run by the Ministry of Interior, which issues the national number and the identity card; the document gives only the year 2011.

The Act defines the National Number as a unique, unrepeatable number given to each citizen on registration and provides for civil registry records stored electronically on computer and a central database; the document gives only the year 2011.
